verdicts.rationale: Commit edef73cc43 modified services/orders/db.py to set statement_timeout to '0' (disabled), removing the previous 5-second safety limit. Disabling the statement timeout allows slow or hanging queries to occupy database connections indefinitely, leading directly to connection pool exhaustion (48 of 50 active connections) and 30-second gateway 504 timeouts on GET /api/orders.

Commit 4339792187 refactored services/orders/queries.py and services/orders/repo.py to separate query and command modules. The diff consists of structural reorganization and telemetry span additions, with no evidence of changing query performance or connection handling.
